svg.title: An internal flip forces infinite ambient trace on product projections
svg.desc: For a generating commuting pair of type II infinity factors P and Q inside a sigma-finite type II infinity M, an internal involution S exchanges P and Q. A nonzero projection p finite in P gives q=SpS and r=pq. Finite ambient trace of r would identify rMr with a spatial product of diffuse finite factors and put its flip inside that product. Haar-unitary powers show every L2 flip intertwiner is zero, a contradiction. All nonzero product projections therefore have infinite ambient trace. The existing free-group generating pair meets this necessary condition but still has extra relative commutants.

g.text: Finite in a copy does not mean finite ambient trace.
M, P, Q have type II∞ · P and Q commute · P ∨ Q = M · SPS = Q · S² = 1
p ≠ 0 finite in P · q = SpS finite in Q · r = pq ≠ 0
SrS = r · suppose 0 < τM(r) < ∞
Normalize only this hypothetical ambient corner: t(x) = τM(x) / τM(r).
A₀ = rPr ≅ pPp · B₀ = rQr ≅ qQq · rMr = A₀ ∨ B₀
Trace uniqueness gives t(ab) = t(a)t(b), for a ∈ A₀ and b ∈ B₀.
The L² multiplication unitary identifies rMr with A₀ ⊗̄ B₀.
Joint generation places rSr inside this spatial tensor product · Lemma 5C.3
Identify B₀ with A₀ = N using the induced flip isomorphism.
Diffuse finite N has v with τ(vᵐ) = 0 for every nonzero integer m.
Tₙζ = (1 ⊗ vⁿ)ζ(v⁻ⁿ ⊗ 1)
Algebraic L² approximation: ⟨ζ, Tₙζ⟩ → 0 for every ζ.
A flip unitary would satisfy Tₙζ = ζ and ⟨ζ, Tₙζ⟩ = 1.
Contradiction: the finite ambient corner cannot exist · Lemmas 5C.1–5C.2
τM(pq) = ∞ for all nonzero projections p ∈ P and q ∈ Q.
General p,q: match finite subprojections using a unitary in Q.
Every nonzero projection in either image copy has infinite ambient trace.
Theorem 5C.4 · endomorphisms of finite positive trace scale are excluded by Corollary 5C.5.
Existing generating pair: p = e ⊗ 1 ⊗ 1, q = 1 ⊗ e ⊗ 1
Rank-one e gives finite corners inside P,Q.
Ambient τM̃(pq) = 1 · Trℓ²(Γ)(1) · 1 = ∞, because Γ is infinite.
It passes this trace test but still has extra commutants · (5C.16), Theorem 5A.7.
Necessary condition; existence of a different full source pair remains open.
Human-source target: Connes, Corollary 11 and Sakai note, author PDF 44–45.
